messages:
Maya: Late-night experiment — looking for short sci-fi films to watch with a synth-heavy album on the side. Nothing too long, ideally 90 mins or less. Mood: neon, slightly melancholy, coffee-fueled. Any pairings?
Oliver: If you haven't seen 'Coherence' (2013) it's perfect — low-fi tension. Pair with 'Boards of Canada' (Music Has the Right to Children) for that eerie analog warmth. :headphones:
Devon: 'The Endless' is longer but vibes well. For short + punchy, 'Prospect' (2018) is cool. For score, try 'Cliff Martinez' (Drive) remixes or 'John Carpenter' synth stuff.
Samir: Quick rec — 'ARQ' on Netflix is a compact time-loop flick. Pair with the 'Trent Reznor & Atticus Ross' OST for that mechanical hum. Also: heavy on bass = good for late coding sessions.
Jen: If you want something super short, watch the short film 'World of Tomorrow' and throw on 'Tycho' for calm ambient synths. Very different but strangely complementary. :sparkles:
Maya: Ooh tycho rec — love that contrast. Anyone have playlists to share? Spotify/YouTube links appreciated.
Oliver: Here's my late-night playlist (public): https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3example (works as a template) — mostly synthwave + ambient.
Devon: Quick poll: do you prefer upbeat synthwave (e.g., The Midnight) or ambient/atmospheric (e.g., Tim Hecker) while watching?
Samir: ambient/atmospheric for sure. Upbeat distracts me. :raised_hand:
Jen: split — upbeat for cooking, ambient for coding+watching. :popcorn:
Maya: musicbot: add "Coherence + Boards of Canada" to #watchlist please
musicbot: Added to watchlist: "Coherence — Boards of Canada" by Maya. Use `/watchlist` to view or `@musicbot recommend` for more suggestions. :robot_face:
Oliver: Bonus weird pick: 'Enter the Void' if you want an intense neon trip, but pair with 'Oneohtrix Point Never' and prepare for a sleepless night. :grimacing:
Maya: Perfect. Thanks all — saving these. If anyone stumbles on short neo-noir sci-fi shorts, ping me. :coffee: "
